text: Yeah, I'm always tired. I have to get up at five fifteen every day.
Not five fifty, five fifteen. Anyway, I go running before work, then I have to catch a six fifty train to the city.
Oh, I see. So, do you go to bed early?
No, I'm a night owl. Last night I was up until one fifteen.
That's not enough sleep, Jake! Maybe you should get a new job.
